mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO luna_wallets (user_id, balance) VALUES (#{userId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT balance FROM luna_wallets WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT balance FROM luna_wallets WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE luna_wallets SET balance = balance + #{delta} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO luna_transactions (id, user_id, delta, reason, ref_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{delta}, #{reason}, #{refId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT used_count FROM daily_usage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND session_date = #{sessionDate} AND kind = #{kind}), 0)
mapper.update: INSERT INTO daily_usage (user_id, session_date, kind, used_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionDate}, #{kind}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE used_count = used_count + 1
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT used FROM lifetime_usage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND kind = #{kind}), 0)
mapper.update: INSERT INTO lifetime_usage (user_id, kind, used) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kind}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE used = used + 1
